Old Wood Texture
(Wood 0047)
It is an old wood material which can be used to texture a wood plank or tree trunk.

The amount of knots, amount of moss, amount of dirt, colour contrast etc. can be managed by the Substance SBSAR file.
White Painted Wood Planks
(Wood 0046)
It is a reclaimed wood planks in white painted. Due to ageing, most of the paint has worn exposing parts of the underlying wood.

The Substance SBSAR file allows you to change the aspect ratio of planks, gap width, offset random, wood grain amount, paint amount, scratch amount, edge wear level etc.
